critical_error.title: Critical Error
critical_error.content: A critical issue occurred while processing your request. Please try again. If this keeps happening, contact support.

planning_failed.title: Planning Failed
planning_failed.content: The planner could not generate or revise a valid execution plan. Please adjust your query and try again.

time_out.title: Time Out
time_out.content: The request took too long to complete and timed out. Please try again with a simpler query.

fail_to_give_answer.title: Fail to Give Answer
fail_to_give_answer.content: The agent completed processing but did not return a usable final answer. Please retry.
